curl -s http://127.0.0.1:36533/color.png -o /tmp/c.png && python3 -c "
import zlib,struct
d=open('/tmp/c.png','rb').read()
i=8;idat=b''
while i<len(d):
    l=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0];t=d[i+4:i+8];c=d[i+8:i+8+l]
    if t==b'IHDR':print(struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c))
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    i+=12+l
r=zlib.decompress(idat);print(len(r),r[:16].hex())
"
